config BMP581_STREAM
	bool "Streaming mode"
	default y
	depends on SENSOR_ASYNC_API
	depends on GPIO
	depends on $(dt_compat_any_has_prop,$(DT_COMPAT_BOSCH_BMP581),int-gpios)

	bool "Emulator for the BMP581 barometric pressure sensor"
	default y
	depends on BMP581
	depends on EMUL
